title: Son, trova and cinema: Cuban culture in song and film
goal: Talk about Cuban music and film with the verbs that change meaning in the past: conocer, saber, querer, poder.
grammar: verbs with aspectual meaning shifts in past tenses

items: I can tell the difference between *conocí* and *conocía*, *supe* and *sabía*, *quise* and *quería*, *pude* and *podía*.
I can say what the son and the Nueva Trova are.
I can use the new words for troubadours, rhythm and lyrics.
